title: Environment overrides for the config
prompt:
Ops want to override the service config from the environment. Add `Config::apply_env(&mut self, vars: &[(&str, &str)])`
in src/lib.rs: `APP_PORT` (a u16), `APP_HOST`, `APP_DEBUG` (`true`/`false`/`1`/`0`) and `APP_WORKERS` (1..=64) override
the fields; other variables are ignored. Invalid values must not change anything: return
`Err(ConfigError { var, value })` for the first invalid one and leave the config as it was (all or nothing).
